plate.title: B08 · Flower-filled ribbon diamonds
plate.description: The broad diamond between actual oblique ribbon families carries a full medallion rather than leaves on its rails. Alternating long and short petals, inner veins and a contrasting collar occupy the room; a second smaller flower marks the ribbon crossing. The source guides remain behind the ornament.

constructionNotes: The broad diamond between actual oblique ribbon families carries a full medallion rather than leaves on its rails.
